# S4.7 — The C3 value-of-compute scheduler: `compute_policy` (`static`/`uniform`/`rules`) binding between `decide` and `envelope.check`, `compute_estimator`, `ComputeDecisionRecord` + `control.compute.{decided,prior_reset}`, `TaskValue` on the contract, `matched_cap` searched-arm commensurability, registry class floors, native-only `scheduling.*` telemetry and `lab/value-of-compute-v1` first execution

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §05e.4 (`R-2.6.4`)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/069_S4.7__value-of-compute-scheduler.md` (sequence 69 of 106)
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.6.4**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.6` (stacked @ `4d44c4b`) ·
**Stage:** 4 ·

## Summary

This lands the scheduling half of the value-of-compute system: the
`compute_policy` component class bound in
`AgentProcess.native.slots["compute_policy"]` and invoked by the control
driver **between `decide` and `envelope.check`** (ADR-0188 D1–D2). The
policy *binds* parameters the strategy left unbound or *tightens* bound
ones — it never proposes, refuses, grants, widens or owns β, and every
bound decision is re-checked by the envelope before persistence
(B-1…B-6 enforced by `check_bound` at the seam, not by convention).

**`hh-control::compute` (new module).** The closed `ComputeOptionKind`
(`continue_as_configured`, `spawn_subagent`, `extend_search`,
`evaluator`, `effort_level`, `alternate_role`, `stop_now`) and
`ComputeInfeasible` (`gauge_at_cap`, `insufficient_budget`,
`undeclared_parallelism`, `no_placement`, `calibration_inactive`,
`capability_unmet`, `prior_unknown`, `policy_excluded`) vocabularies;
`MarginalValueEstimate`/`RiskEstimate`; `ComputeDecisionRecord` with
canonical JSON codec and content address; `ComputeContext`/`ComputeFacts`;
`BindOutcome{Bound|Unchanged}`; typed `ComputeError`s
(`PolicyInvalid`, `EstimatorBudgetExhausted`, `PriorUnknown`,
`TaskValueMissing`, `VariantNotAdmitted`); the `advise` verb returning a
typed `ComputeAdvice` (default `None` — C3 variants never advise);
`compute_decision_outcome` + `explain` projections; the
evolution-delta classifier (a `child_floor`/`k_max`/`budget_share_cap`
increase is `BudgetDelta::Loosening`, refused — `amend` is absent from
the verb set). `StaticPolicy` is the packaged null (the driver
short-circuits on its empty `options_supported` — zero
`control.compute.*` rows, byte-identical modulo ids); `UniformPolicy`
binds every feasible option at its declared maximum (the recipe
baseline); `RulesPolicy` is the C3 estimator baseline — five conditioned
rules over typed inputs only, **no model calls**. `policy_for` refuses
`bandit`/`surface_prior`/`predictor` with `VariantNotAdmitted`, never
silently — their implementations are Stage 5/6.

**Driver seam.** `decide → compute_policy.bind(d, ctx) → envelope.check(d′)
→ control.compute.decided → control.decision{compute_decision_ref}`.
`compute_ctx` folds the durable prefix (`remaining`/`reserved`, live
fan-out vs spawned/terminal rows, samples from `model.call.completed`
response refs, validator-verdict + format-failure streaks, priors cleared
on drift/supersession newer than the last reset — landing
`control.compute.prior_reset` first) and merges the sealed `ComputeFacts`
for everything the definition declares. Typed degradations
(`EstimatorBudgetExhausted`/`TaskValueMissing`/`PolicyInvalid` post-check)
become `Unchanged` with a degraded record — never a stop, never an
unverifiable binding. `lifecycle.run.finished` gains `compute_decisions`;
`RunManifest` gains `compute_policy_ref`.

**Contracts.** `hh-verification` `TaskValue{success_value, failure_cost |
from_reversibility, currency}` is a `TaskContract` member projected at
seal from the goal extension; a missing value yields `unknown` estimates
/`TaskValueMissing` → `Unchanged`, never a guess. `hh-embed` reads
`slots["compute_policy"]` (pre-S4.7 arms decode `static`), admits the
variant through `policy_for` at arm time, stamps the manifest, and feeds
the contract's `task_value` into `compute_facts`.

**Matched-budget conditionality.** `hh_budget::matchspec::validate_match`
extends `matched_cap` equality to the union of declared dimensions and
every hard-cap dimension across all arms' `search_budget`: equal
undeclared caps admit; unequal caps — a searched arm against zero-cap
comparands, or search spend on a dim the spec does not name — refuse
`UnequalCaps` → `IncommensurableMatch` at `register` (AC-R-2.6.4-12).
Searched arms remain legal under `matched_total`.

**Registry, telemetry, recipe.** `compute_policy` and
`compute_estimator` `ClassRecord`s carry the §5e.4 contract ops
(`capabilities`/`bind`/`advise`/`observe`/`explain`; `estimate`) at tier
C3, registered floors-only (no suite/variants — packaged variants resolve
through `policy_for`). The six canonical `scheduling.*` metrics are
declared `applies_to = {native}` — hosted participants render typed
`n/a{class}` (T-LCD-06/-07/-15). `lab/value-of-compute-v1` executes its
first registration: 12 `matched_cap` arms (3 policies × 2 model families
× 2 eval budgets) plus an `iso_cost` companion; searched-arm exemplar
tests prove both refusal paths.

## Acceptance criteria (deterministic rows are executable)

- **AC-R-2.6.4-1** — `compute::tests::static_is_inert`;
  `driver::tests::static_compute_policy_appends_no_compute_rows` (zero
  `control.compute.*` rows through the full driver loop).
- **AC-R-2.6.4-2** — `check_bound_refuses_{kind_change_and_widening,
  k_widening}`; `policy_for_refuses_unadmitted`; the driver re-checks
  every bound decision before the record lands.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-3** — `reserve_fits` gates every emitted option;
  `bind_compute` degrades a would-be-refused binding to `Unchanged`.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-4** — `uniform_compute_policy_binds_through_the_driver_seam`
  (all 7 options in `options_considered[]`); `compute_decision_outcome` +
  `explain` projections.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-5** — `rules`/`uniform` declare
  `makes_model_calls: false`; `cost_of_estimation` is on the record.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-6** — `rules_extend_search_{stops_at_agreement,
  runs_to_kmax_on_disagreement,unknown_without_reducer}`.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-7** — `spawn_subagent_{undeclared_parallelism,
  binds_slice_within_share}` (slice ≤ `remaining ÷ (steps + 1)`).
- **AC-R-2.6.4-8** — `evaluator_{requires_active_calibration,
  binds_on_positive_rule}`.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-10** — `compute_rule_delta_classifies_loosening`;
  `amend` is absent from the trait.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-11** — `bind_is_pure`.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-12** — `hh-budget::matched_cap_{refuses_searched_arm_off_
  the_declared_dims,admits_equal_undeclared_search_caps}`;
  `hh-lab::value_of_compute_v1_refuses_a_searched_arm_under_matched_cap`
  (declared-dim + undeclared-dim cases).
- **AC-R-2.6.4-14** — `scheduling.*` rows `applies_to = {native}`;
  hh-telemetry catalogue/view suites green.
- **AC-R-2.6.4-9/-13** are Stage-5 criteria (outside this ticket's gating
  set); the surfaces they ride — `control.compute.prior_reset` + emit
  path, `advise`, staged variant refs — are landed typed.
- **removability(0…3)** — `check-removability.sh` green (below).

## Deviation / decision records

`docs/adr/ADR-0299` — scheduler contract housed in `hh-control` (no new
leaf crate); typed `ComputeAdvice` crosses the context seam (no
hh-context dependency, no new `CandidateKind`); searched-arm rule enforced
as cap-equality over union dims in `hh_budget` (not a lab blanket rule);
floors-only class registration; `TaskValue` projection semantics; a
spawned child never inherits `compute_policy_ref`.
